metadata.description: Unleash feature management skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: unleash
plugins.description: Manage Unleash feature flags from Claude Code: evaluate whether a change needs a flag, create flags with consistent naming, wrap code behind flags, plan progressive rollouts, clean up stale flags, and migrate flags from GitLab to Unleash. Bundles the Unleash MCP server, a customizable FeatureOps skill, and a GitLab migration skill.
